---
title: "Macrophage Gene Expression in Melanoma"
author: "Yani Xu"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
expr <- read.csv("data/sample_expression.csv", check.names = FALSE)
expr_long <- melt(expr, id.vars = "gene", variable.name = "sample", value.name = "expression")
expr_long$expression <- as.numeric(as.character(expr_long$expression))
expr_matrix <- as.matrix(expr[, -1])
rownames(expr_matrix) <- expr[, 1]
cor_mat <- cor(t(expr_matrix))

stats <- sapply(unique(expr_long$gene), function(g) {
  v <- expr_long$expression[expr_long$gene == g]
  c(Mean = round(mean(v), 2), Median = round(median(v), 2),
    SD = round(sd(v), 2), Min = round(min(v), 2), Max = round(max(v), 2))
})
```

Overview
=======================================================================

### Data Summary

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
cat("Genes:", nrow(expr), "| Samples:", ncol(expr) - 1, "| Tumor: TCGA-SKCM\n")
```

### Expression Statistics

```{r stats-table, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(t(stats), digits = 2, caption = "Expression Summary (Normalized Counts)")
```

Gene Expression
=======================================================================

### Boxplot

```{r boxplot, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = gene, y = expression, fill = gene)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(title = "Macrophage Gene Expression in TCGA-SKCM",
       x = "Gene", y = "Expression (log10)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Expression Density

```{r density, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = expression, color = gene, fill = gene)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(title = "Expression Density by Gene", x = "Expression (log10)", y = "Density") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
```

Correlation
=======================================================================

### Correlation Heatmap

```{r heatmap, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
heatmap(cor_mat,
        col = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
        main = "Gene Expression Correlation", cexRow = 1, cexCol = 1, margins = c(8, 8))
```

### Top Correlated Pairs

```{r cor-table, echo=FALSE}
cor_df <- melt(cor_mat)
names(cor_df) <- c("Gene1", "Gene2", "Correlation")
cor_df <- cor_df[cor_df$Gene1 != cor_df$Gene2, ]
cor_df <- cor_df[order(-abs(cor_df$Correlation)), ]
knitr::kable(head(cor_df, 10), digits = 3, caption = "Top 10 Correlated Pairs")
```

Findings
=======================================================================

### Summary

```{r findings, echo=FALSE}
cat("Findings:\n")
cat("1. CD68 highest expression (pan-macrophage marker).\n")
cat("2. C1QA, C1QB, C1QC strongly correlated (C1 complex).\n")
cat("3. CD163 and MRC1 moderate correlation (M2 macrophage).\n")
cat("4. CD68 most variable, CSF1R least variable across samples.\n")
```
